content: Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) and Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) are conditions that can be effectively screened for using cost-efficient methods recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). One such method involves the use of the FIB-4 index. The FIB-4 score is determined by taking into account the patient’s age, levels of alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST), as well as their platelet count.
